meta.title: Shirazi & Associates — Immigration & Family Law, Toronto
meta.description: Persian-speaking immigration and family lawyers in Toronto, serving newcomers and families across Ontario.

hero.headline: A steady hand for the hardest year of your life.
hero.echo: همراهی مطمئن در سخت‌ترین سال زندگی شما.
hero.lede: Persian-speaking immigration and family lawyers serving newcomers and families across Ontario. We explain every step in the language you think in.

facts.label: Consultations
facts.note: First 30 minutes, in English or Farsi. No obligation.

facts.label: Based in
facts.note: Serving all of Ontario — in person, by phone, or online.

facts.label: Practice
facts.note: Immigration and family law. Nothing else, on purpose.

practice.heading: Two areas of law, practised properly.

overlap.title: Where they meet
overlap.body: A separation can put your status at risk. A sponsorship can collapse mid-application. Most firms hand you to a second lawyer at exactly that moment — we don't.

process.heading: You will always know what happens next.

steps.title: Talk to us
steps.body: Thirty minutes, free, in the language you prefer. Tell us the situation — we'll tell you honestly whether you need a lawyer at all.

steps.title: A written plan
steps.body: Before any money changes hands you receive the strategy, the timeline, and a flat fee where possible — in both languages.

steps.title: We do the work
steps.body: Filings, correspondence, and hearings handled by us. You get an update at every stage, whether or not there is news.

counsel.name: Nasrin Shirazi
counsel.quote: “I arrived here at nineteen with a file I couldn't read. Nobody should have to argue for their own family in a second language.”
counsel.body: Called to the bar in Ontario, with fifteen years spent almost entirely on immigration and family files for Persian-speaking clients. Appears before the IRB, the Federal Court, and the Ontario Superior Court of Justice.

contact.heading: Tell us what's happening.
contact.lede: Every enquiry is read by a lawyer, not an intake form. We reply within one business day — and if your matter is urgent, say so and we'll move it up.

form.name: Your name
form.contactError: We need one way to reach you.
form.messageHint: Write in English or Farsi — whichever is easier. Both are read by a lawyer.
form.disclaimer: Sending this message does not create a solicitor–client relationship. Please don't include confidential details until we've confirmed we can act for you.
